Isso. Primeiro redesenhar o processo; de: That’s right. Redesign the process first; then give the agent an owner, an authority limit, and a way to measure it.
Mais passos só aumentam a chance de falt: More steps only increase the chance of missing one. The problem is the format of the request, not its length.
Isso. Dizer o destino (objetivo, restriç: That’s right. State the destination (goal, constraints, resources, and criteria), and put the best way to do the work in a reusable manual.
Changing tools doesn’t change the request. The same 30-step request fails in any of them.
Em uso, o modelo não aprende sozinho. Os: In use, the model doesn’t learn on its own. Its weights are frozen.
Isso. Contexto, regras, exemplos e memór: That’s right. Context, rules, examples, and memory adjusted with each cycle. The system around the model is what learns.
Pode ser coincidência, mas a área mostra: It may be a coincidence, but the area shows that the difference comes from the environment you cultivated.
O modelo mais novo não resolve. Se as re: The newest model won’t solve it. If the rules stay tied to the tool, the problem will return the next time you switch.
Isso. Separar o que serve a qualquer IA: That’s right. Separate what works with any AI and test it in a new conversation. The file existing isn’t proof; the AI using it is.
Apagar o histórico antigo não ajuda. Nad: Deleting the old history doesn’t help. Nothing needs to be deleted; the method starts by simply listing what exists.
O modelo pode ser ótimo e ainda assim de: The model can be excellent and still miss its own error. The problem is who reviews it, not the AI’s quality.
Isso. Quem escreveu tende a aprovar o qu: That’s right. Whoever wrote it tends to approve their own work. A second reader helps, and the test and you make the decision.
Mais rodadas com a mesma autora repetem: More rounds with the same author repeat the same blind spot. The page still limits you to two rounds.
O v2 é o percurso técnico, com oito módu: The v2 is the technical path, with eight modules and a terminal. It’s too demanding for someone with little time and no foundation.
O v6.2 é o percurso completo em 48 aulas: The v6.2 is the complete path in 48 lessons. It works for beginners, but not for someone with little time.
Isso. A página descreve o Quick como ver: That’s right. The page describes Quick as a short, visual version for professionals 40+, with seven lessons and about 77 minutes. The v5 works too, with longer lessons.
Nota maior nos exemplos usados para ajus: A higher score on the examples used for adjustments may only reflect tuning to those examples. Proof outside them is missing.
Isso. A mudança precisa se sustentar em: That’s right. The change needs to hold up on reserved examples, using the same criteria. More attempts don’t prove overall improvement.
Mais tentativas nos mesmos exemplos só r: More attempts on the same examples only reinforce tuning to them. What’s missing is an example no one has used.
Os casos e as respostas do laboratório s: The lab cases and responses are simulated and written by the project itself. Getting them right doesn’t show how the model performs with real data.
Isso. Os 20 casos são autorais e simulad: That’s right. The 20 cases are original and simulated; they’re useful for studying how requests are framed, policies, and errors. Quality requires independent data and a human reference.
Mais casos simulados continuam sendo sim: More simulated cases are still simulations. What’s missing is a comparison with real data and a person’s decision.
O diagnóstico só observa. Ele não confer: The diagnosis only observes. It doesn’t check whether whoever calls the action has permission to do so.
Isso. O diagnóstico prova o que é visíve: That’s right. The diagnosis proves what is visible; permission, real effects, and safe repetition require human review.
A nota não garante segurança. Ela mede s: The score doesn’t guarantee safety. It measures observable signals, not what happens behind the page.
Sua equipe tem dois assistentes de IA e: Your team has two AI assistants, and one of them made a mistake with a customer. What is the first management question to ask?
Quem responde pelo resultado dele. Sem u: Who is accountable for its results? Without a name, no one corrects it, no one measures it, and the mistake happens again.
O que muda entre a descrição de cargo de: What changes between a person's job description and an agent sheet?
O agente precisa do contexto escrito e d: The agent needs written context and an explicit authority limit: what it decides on its own, what it confirms, and what it never does.
Você vai pôr um agente num processo que: You’re going to put an agent in a process that has existed for ten years. What do you check first?
Se o processo ainda deveria existir dess: Whether the process should still exist in its current form. Steps that existed only because there was no other way should be removed before the agent is brought in.
Você pede à IA toda semana a mesma mensa: Every week, you ask AI for the same message, each time with a different detail. How do you turn this into responsibility?
Troque o \"escreva esta mensagem\" por \: Replace “write this message” with “take care of...” and state the goal, the limits, and how you’ll judge the result.
A IA entregou um texto errado mesmo com: AI delivered an incorrect text even though you gave it a long request. How do you find out what was missing?
Olhe a escada: faltou contexto, faltou o: Check the ladder: was context missing, were instructions on how to do it missing, or was the standard for good work missing? Making the request longer rarely solves it.
Um agente vai mexer em algo que gasta di: An agent is going to handle something that costs money. What level of the matrix does that belong to?
Em \"propõe e eu aprovo\", com um dono n: At “propose and I approve,” with a named owner. It must never touch anything irreversible.
Seu agente responde bem na primeira sema: Your agent responds well in the first week, then repeats the same mistakes. What elements are probably missing?
Os que fazem melhorar: exemplos anotados: The ones that help it improve: annotated examples, evaluation, and feedback that goes back into the file. Without them, the agent stalls.
Você corrigiu o agente numa conversa e,: You corrected the agent in a conversation, and days later the mistake came back. What should you do differently?
Registrar a falha numa linha do diário e: Record the failure in one line in the log and put the correction in the agent’s file. The conversation gets lost; the file stays.
Um agente novo vai responder clientes. E: A new agent is going to respond to customers. What autonomy level should it start at?
No nível 1: ele propõe e uma pessoa exec: Level 1: it proposes, and a person carries it out. It moves up a level only after cycles with no new failures.
You’re going to test another AI chat tomorrow. What do you check today before switching?
Onde estão escritas as regras e decisões: Where the rules and decisions you gave the current chat are written down. Anything that exists only inside it is lost when you switch.
A IA nova respondeu diferente do esperad: The new AI responded differently than you expected, even though you pasted in the document. What is the most likely diagnosis?
Ela não usou o documento. Peça que cite: It didn’t use the document. Ask it to cite which part each rule came from: the file existing is no proof; the AI using it is.
Uma regra antiga do seu documento foi tr: An old rule in your document was replaced with another one. What should you do with the old rule?
Não apagar: marcar como substituída e ap: Don’t delete it: mark it as replaced and point to the new one. That way, the AI stops following the old rule, and the history stays recorded.
Você tem um relatório feito por IA para: You have an AI-generated report to send to the director and only ten minutes. Which review is most valuable?
Colar o pedido original e o relatório in: Paste the original request and the full report into a second AI and ask only for findings with minimal corrections. A summary won’t do.
A revisora apontou sete achados e dois p: The reviewer found seven issues, and two seem exaggerated. What should you do with them?
Marcar cada um: resolvido, recusado com: Mark each one: resolved, rejected with a reason, or pending. You don’t have to accept everything; the final decision is yours.
Depois da segunda rodada as duas IAs ain: After the second round, the two AIs still disagree. Why not open a third one?
A página limita a duas rodadas: mais rod: The page limits you to two rounds: more rounds take time without proving anything. Decide using a test or your own criteria.
Você vai parar a revisão hoje e retomar: You’re going to stop reviewing today and pick it back up tomorrow. What do you write down?
Um bilhete curto: o estado do texto, as: A short note: the text’s status, the decisions made, and the next action.

O OSWork v6.2: o mesmo percurso do v2, e: OSWork v6.2: the same path as v2, in short, visual lessons, with a glossary.

Não. A página diz que dá para iniciar pe: No. The page says you can start with the fundamentals without programming; v6, v5, and Quick don’t even ask for it.
Você terminou a primeira aula da edição: You finished the first lesson of the edition you chose. What should be in your practice folder?
O primeiro resultado guardado e uma dúvi: Your first saved result and a recorded question, so you can return to your journey.
Um fornecedor diz que o assistente dele: A vendor says their assistant “learns on its own.” What do you ask first?
Em qual nível: se ele refaz a resposta,: At what level: whether it redoes the answer, changes its own instructions, or helps produce future improvements (investigate the recursion), and how that was measured.
Você mudou três frases do pedido de uma: You changed three sentences in the request at once, and the result improved. What can’t you tell?
Qual das três mudanças ajudou. Por isso: Which of the three changes helped. That’s why the cycle tests one change at a time.
A versão nova acertou nos exemplos de aj: The new version got the adjustment examples right and the reserved case wrong. What should you do?
Manter a versão antiga até entender o er: Keep the old version until you understand the error. The reserved example is the proof that the change holds up.
Você quer que a IA diga se cada devoluçã: You want AI to say whether each customer return is due to a defect, the wrong size, or buyer’s remorse. What kind of question should you use?
Choice: são alternativas explícitas e a: Choice: these are explicit alternatives, and the answer is one of them. The criteria say what makes each option correct.
A IA acertou os três casos de teste que: AI got the three test cases you created right. Is it ready to automate?
Não. Três exemplos mostram que a pergunt: No. Three examples show that the question works, not that it’s high quality. You still need to compare it with your decision across a larger set of real cases.
Um pedido chega com dois assuntos mistur: A request comes in with two subjects mixed together, and AI chose a queue. Where’s the problem?
Na política: casos com dois assuntos ou: In the policy: cases with two subjects or missing information should go to human review, and that needs to be written in the request.
Um colega diz que o Jev acerta 83% porqu: A colleague says Jev is 83% accurate because the page cites 20 out of 24. What do you say?
Esse número é das regras simples, em ped: That number is for simple rules, using fictional requests. It’s not a result from Jev.
Um cliente diz que perguntou ao assisten: A customer says they asked the AI assistant whether you had a product, and the answer was wrong. Where do you start investigating?
No diagnóstico do seu site. Ele mostra s: With your site’s diagnosis. It shows whether the page presents itself well to outside readers, including agents and assistants.
Seu primeiro diagnóstico acusou a falta: Your first diagnosis flagged the missing public files. Which fix on the list addresses this?
A correção 2: publicar robots.txt, sitem: Fix 2: publish robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt. Then run the diagnosis again and compare.
A equipe quer oferecer aos agentes uma p: The team wants to offer agents a first action on the site. Which one should you choose?
Uma que não muda nada perigoso, como uma: One that doesn’t change anything risky, such as a search or a status check. Actions that change something require human confirmation.
